parameters.description: The language of the response. Valid values: - zh: Chinese. - en: English. Default value: en.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword of the zone name. The search is not case-sensitive. You can set the SearchMode parameter to switch between exact search and fuzzy search. The default mode is fuzzy search.

parameters.name: SearchMode
parameters.description: The search mode. This parameter takes effect only when the Keyword parameter is specified. Valid values: - **LIKE**: fuzzy search (default) - **EXACT**: exact search Default value: **LIKE**.

parameters.name: QueryRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the VPC that is associated with the zone.

parameters.name: QueryVpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC that is associated with the zone.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the zone belongs.

parameters.name: ZoneType
parameters.description: The type of the zones to query. Valid values: - **AUTH\_ZONE**: authoritative zones. - **CLOUD\_PRODUCT\_ZONE**: zones for cloud services. Default value: **AUTH\_ZONE**.

parameters.name: ZoneTag
parameters.description: The list of cloud service types.

parameters.name: ResourceTag
parameters.description: The resource tags that are added to the zone.

children.name: Key
children.description: The key of the resource tag.

children.name: Value
children.description: The value of the resource tag.

ListTagResources.summary: Queries the tags that are added to resources in Private Zone.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the response. Valid values: - zh: Chinese - en: English Default value: en.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to ZONE.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to start the next query. It is returned in the response to the previous query.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 200. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: A list of resource IDs. In this case, a list of zone IDs. You can specify up to 50 IDs.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: A list of tags.

children.name: Key
children.description: The key of the tag.

children.name: Value
children.description: The value of the tag.
